name: Carbon network for Li-ion channels
description: Benzene rings linked at 1,3,5 through alkyne (ethynylene, -C#C-) linkers, as in conjugated microporous polymers: seeded, grown and zipped into a network, with a rigid-body geometry optimisation (GAFF 1.81 parameters, params/gaff_benzene_alkyne) after each pass, then analysed with Poreblazer. The goal is a percolating pore network whose pore limiting diameter admits a lithium ion (a bare Li+ is about 1.52 A across; a solvated one several times that).
